resCmpData.re_desc_note_fin: Notes:1.In terms of Regulation 33 of SEBI  LODR Regulations 2015 this statement of Unaudited Financials Results of Company for quarter & nine months ended 31.12.24 have been reviewed by Audit Committee and approved by Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 30.1.25.   2.During nine months ended 31.12.24, 52510 equity shares were issued to employee's of the Company against stock options exercised by them.   3.Company has only one reportable segment -Branded Fashion apparel and accessories   4.Board of Directors of Company & Manyavar Creations Pvt Ltd, wholly owned subsidary of the Company at their respective meetings held on 25.1.24 had approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Manyavar Creations Pvt Ltd with the Company under Sec 230 to 232 of Company Act 2013 read with Companies (Compromises, Arrangements and Amalgamations) Rules, 2016.Scheme of Amalgamation was approved by the  NCLT vide its orders dated 11.11.24 (the  Scheme) with retrospective appointed date 01.04.24. Accordingly corresponding amounts for quarters ended 30.9.24 and 31.12.23,  nine month ended 31.12.23 and year ended 31.03.24 have been restated by the Company after recognising effect of scheme as per applicable accounting standard.Amalgamation has been accounted in accordance with Appendix C of Ind AS 103 - Business Combinations as common control transaction using the pooling of interest method. Accordingly all assets, liabilities & reserve of Manyavar Creations Pvt Ltd as on 01.4.24 were transferred to the Company at the book values appearing in the Consolidated books of the Company immediately before the amalgamation and the value of Investment was cancelled.Effect of amalgamation on amount of the standalone revenue & profit & loss published in previous periods are as shown
